caseNameFull: Livingston v. Texas Granviel v. Texas Harris v. Georgia
judges: Brennan, Certiorari, Death, Insofar, Sentences, Undisturbed

opinions.text:
Ct. Crim. App. Tex.; Ct. Crim, App. Tex.; and Sup. Ct. Ga. Certiorari denied.

Mr. Justice Brennan and Mr. Justice Marshall would grant certiorari and vacate judgments insofar as they leave undisturbed the sentences of death.

See Gregg v. Georgia, 428 U. S. 153, 227 (1976) (Brennan, J., dissenting); id., at 231 (Marshall, J., dissenting).
